headline: Pelita Air Awards Customers As BYD Faces Government Scrutiny
seoTitle: Pelita Air Rewards and BYD Production Updates
metaDescription: Pelita Air rewards loyal customers with electric vehicles as Minister of Industry Sarmuji reviews BYD's manufacturing operations in Indonesia.
aiSummaryBullets: Pelita Air awarded three electric cars to customers with the highest transaction values during its High Spender loyalty program.
Minister of Industry Sarmuji visited the new BYD facility in Subang to address local employment concerns following community protests.
The government has requested that BYD increase its local content requirements for electric vehicle production starting in 2027.
aiContextParagraph: The aviation sector and the automotive industry have converged in recent news regarding BYD's presence in Indonesia. Pelita Air successfully concluded a loyalty initiative, distributing three BYD electric vehicles to its top-spending passengers. Simultaneously, the company's manufacturing activities have come under government review. Minister of Industry Sarmuji visited the company's new production site in Subang, West Java, following demonstrations from local groups regarding labor absorption. During this visit, discussions focused on the potential for increased investment, including a proposed battery manufacturing facility. Furthermore, the Ministry of Industry has challenged the company to elevate its local component levels, known as TKDN, for electric vehicles by 2027. BYD, which reports having sold 19 million units globally, stated its Subang factory has an annual production capacity of 150,000 units.
whyItIsViral: The story gained traction through a combination of corporate marketing activity and high-profile government interventions regarding foreign investment policies.
